title: Disney Mein Har Jagah Dustbin Kyun? 🤯 Hidden Secret!
description:
Disney trash can secret finally revealed! Kya aapne kabhi notice kiya hai ki Disney parks mein har jagah dustbin perfectly placed hota hai? Ye koi coincidence nahi hai. Walt Disney ne ek simple observation se ek aisa rule banaya jo aaj bhi duniya ke sabse clean theme parks ka secret hai.

Legend ke according, Walt Disney ne calculate kiya tha ki log average 30 steps chalne ke baad apna trash gira dete hain. Isi liye Disneyland mein har 30 steps par trash cans lagaye gaye. Is small psychology trick ki wajah se Disney parks duniya ke sabse clean aur organized places ban gaye.
